description: The two scoping codes side by side in one program, each on the read that earns it: `:count` is bound by the root scope and hidden by `draw_steps`'s boundary, so it is `ol-var-not-visible` naming that procedure; `:multiplier` is bound only by a block that has ended, so it is `ol-undefined-var` (spec/error-model.md:102,132). Both are asserted, in source order — measured, a checker that reports only the first scoping diagnostic it finds satisfies every single-diagnostic fixture in this corpus and fails this one. `draw_steps` is never called, so the runtime never reaches its body at all and only the semantic stage can make this assertion.
